description: This is a test script for the ImageAI library's custom video object detection functionality. It includes test functions for different model types, uses mocking for callback functions, and manages temporary files during testing.

classes.name: CallbackFunctions
classes.description: Contains callback functions for processing each frame and second during video detection, with assertions to verify output types.

methods.name: delete_cache
methods.description: Deletes specified cache files if they exist.

methods.name: test_video_detection_yolov3
methods.description: Tests object detection on a video using the YOLOv3 model, verifies output file creation.

methods.name: test_video_detection_tiny_yolov3
methods.description: Tests object detection on a video using the Tiny YOLOv3 model, verifies output file creation.

methods.name: test_video_detection_yolo_analysis
methods.description: Tests object detection with callback functions and verifies that callbacks are called.
